author: OPERON (HeartVector project)
rationale: Completes the aging hierarchy (ms phase clocks -> min perturbations -> 7-day movement -> years structural aging). Mirrors HeartVector A/D: a shared structure-function aging axis plus an orthogonal locomotor-reserve residual. This lock is written BEFORE any outcome (physical-function score OR mortality) is read.

data_sources.cohort: NHANES 2005-2006 (cycle D) — the ONLY cycle with BOTH whole-body DXA and minute-level accelerometry
data_sources.DXA: DXX_D.XPT (whole-body, 5 multiply-imputed replicates/person; ages 8-69 only) + DXXAG_D.XPT (android/gynoid)
data_sources.accelerometry: PAXRAW_D.ZIP (minute-level intensity counts + step flag, up to 10,080 min/person over 7 days), 449MB
data_sources.physical_function: PFQ_D.XPT (self-reported walking/stairs/chair-rise/stooping/standing difficulty) — PRIMARY OUTCOME (soft, self-report; stated as limitation)
data_sources.body_measures: BMX_D.XPT (BMI), DEMO_D.XPT (age, sex, survey design SDMVPSU/SDMVSTRA/WTMEC2YR)
data_sources.mortality: NHANES public-use linked mortality (through 2019) — SECONDARY, quarantined until reserve is frozen

verified_overlap.note: accelerometry valid-day filter will subset further; expected analysis n ~2500-3500

clock_1_structural_age.method: cross-fitted (5-fold) ElasticNetCV, trained on OUTCOME-BLIND healthy calibration subset only; age-bias-corrected residual = structural age-gap; mirrors BodyVector construction exactly
predictors: femoral/total-femur region BMD proxies via DXA regional BMD (legs, pelvis, spine, arms, ribs, head)
clock_1_structural_age.imputation_handling: average the 5 DXA multiply-imputed replicates per SEQN (or Rubin's rules); frozen choice = mean of replicates

clock_2_locomotor_age.method: identical cross-fitted ElasticNetCV pipeline, outcome-blind healthy calibration
clock_2_locomotor_age.valid_day_rule: >=4 valid days (>=10 wear-hours/day, PAXCAL==1 & PAXSTAT==1); frozen BEFORE feature computation

reserve_definition.FROZEN_CHOICE: locomotor_reserve = residual of locomotor_age_gap after regressing out the SHARED structure-function aging axis (orthogonal residual, NOT a ratio)
reserve_definition.rationale_for_change: A ratio is unstable near zero denominator and sign-flips; every other HeartVector/BodyVector construct uses an orthogonal residual / Mahalanobis. Same interpretation (movement younger/older than skeleton predicts), stable statistics, on-brand.
reserve_definition.shared_axis: first principal axis of standardized [structural_gap, locomotor_gap] on the healthy calibration set (2D analog of u0=ones/sqrt(2)); reserve = component orthogonal to it
reserve_definition.sign_convention: positive reserve = movement YOUNGER than skeletal substrate predicts (preserved function); negative = movement older (functional vulnerability)

prespecified_tests.PRIMARY: Does locomotor_reserve explain a frozen lower-body physical-function score beyond age + sex + BMI + shared structure-function age? (ordinal/logistic on PFQ-derived lower-body limitation; LRT, alpha=0.05 two-sided; success = p<0.05 AND reserve coefficient in hypothesized direction)
prespecified_tests.SECONDARY_mortality: reserve -> all-cause mortality beyond age+sex+shared-axis (survey-weighted Cox); reported as secondary, event count expected LOW (younger DXA cohort)
prespecified_tests.LOAD_BEARING_CONTRAST: prespecified: do load-bearing regions (legs, pelvis, femur, lumbar spine) show steeper structural age-gradient than control regions (arms, ribs), and does the load-bearing structural gap track objective locomotion better than the control-region gap? (paired comparison of region-specific age-gap vs accelerometry correlation)

honesty_constraints: Primary outcome (PFQ) is SELF-REPORTED physical function — stated as a limitation; accelerometry is the PREDICTOR not the outcome.
Cohort is ages 8-69 (DXA exclusion of 70+), skews young (median 41) -> few deaths -> mortality is secondary and underpowered.
n ~2500-3500 after valid-day filter -> smaller than CODE/EchoNext; this is a FUNCTIONAL-LAYER completion, NOT a new headline.
DXA and CT are independent modalities/cohorts: phrase any CT convergence as 'cross-modal convergence', never causal.
'structure-function discordance', NOT 'bone deterioration caused movement changes'.
This track does NOT touch the held CODE confirmatory reveal and does not alter the A-vs-D dissociation headline.
firewall: Physical-function and mortality outcomes are NOT read until clock_1, clock_2, and reserve are computed and frozen. Prespecification hashed below.
does_not_gate: Independent of CODE confirmatory reveal (still user-gated) and of all EchoNext/Chapman/perturbation results.
